Sir John Aubrey , 2nd Baronet ( c. 1650 - 15 September 1700 ) was an English politician . He was the only surviving son of Sir John Aubrey , 1st Baronet , and his wife Mary South , daughter of Sir Richard South . Aubrey matriculated from Jesus College , Oxford , in 1668 , and was called to the bar by the Middle Temple in 1672 . He succeeded his father as baronet in 1679 , and was High Sheriff of Glamorganshire in 1685 . Aubrey was Member of Parliament ( MP ) for Brackley from 1698 to his death in 1700 . On 1 March 1678 , he married firstly Margaret Lowther , daughter of Sir John Lowther , 1st Baronet in St James 's in London . By 1691 , he married secondly Mary Jephson , daughter of William Lewis and widow of William Jephson . Aubrey died at Boarstall in Buckinghamshire after a fall from his horse and was buried at the old family home Llantrithyd in Glamorgan . His only son John succeeded to the baronetcy .
